_note: Emissive layer of the pirate kit (docs/art/pirates-style.md section 14): per tile, the pixels that give light. 'codes' marks every pixel of those kit colours (inside 'box' [x0,y0,x1,y1] if given) as glowing in its own colour; 'px' marks single pixels with a glow colour of their own. 'strength' 0-1 scales the glow (default 1). Built by scripts/emissive.py. CC BY 4.0.
